description: Defines a JPA entity class representing a product in the backend of a grocery shopping application, including properties such as name, description, category, price, image URL, stock, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Represents a product available for purchase in the grocery backend, with properties for product details and metadata, mapped to the 'products' database table.

methods.name: Product
methods.description: Default constructor for creating an empty Product instance.

methods.name: Product
methods.description: Parameterized constructor for creating a Product with specific details.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the product.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the product.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the product.

methods.name: getImageUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL of the product's image.

methods.name: setImageUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL of the product's image.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the product was created.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Determines equality based on the product's ID.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code for the product, based on its ID.
